labs.outcome: Review a saved plan and use an explicitly invoked protected deployment workflow.
labs.mechanism: A saved plan is the artifact reviewed for a particular operation and state snapshot. Replanning at apply time can invalidate that review. The local rehearsal binds root, operation, source hashes, plan hash and age, while a protected real workflow adds authentication, backend locking and controlled artifact access.

labs.expected: The exact reviewed artifact applies; tampered and wrong-operation artifacts fail before Terraform apply.

labs.outcome: Recover ownership and state, resume interrupted work, and review provider upgrades.
labs.mechanism: An interrupted apply can leave both real resources and partial state, so recovery starts by observing rather than blindly rerunning destructive commands. Restoring state affects bindings and must be reconciled with actual resources. Provider upgrades require lockfile review and a plan because schema compatibility does not guarantee unchanged behavior.
labs.probe: Rehearse the local recovery example and compare version/lockfile changes with a fresh plan.
labs.expected: Recovery preserves the intended object bindings and exposes changes before upgrade apply.
